avatarNodeName.description: Server-assigned avatar node name for this session

canPlaceTeleporters.description: True when this session may place teleporter pads (world owner, policy permits owner mutation)

canEdit.description: True when this session may edit the world (world owner, policy permits owner mutation)

signedIn.description: signin-sync I1 — true when the server admitted this socket as a signed-in user. Present in every hello this server sends; NOT required, because a client may talk to another or older Atrium server. Absent means unknown, never anonymous.

userId.description: signin-sync I1 — the admitted user's id, present exactly when signedIn is true

scriptHost.description: scripting-4b-1 E4/E5 — true when this session holds the world's script-host role

hostGen.description: scripting-4b-1 E5 — the host generation, present exactly when scriptHost is true
